channel.title: ThisWeek Desktop Updates
channel.description: Signed updates for the current ThisWeek desktop app.

item.description:
ThisWeek Desktop 0.1.22

Enhanced notes now include Action Items plus Share, Regenerate, and Delete — matching the web app.

  • Extract, complete, dismiss, edit, and convert action items from a summary.
  • Share a public summary link, regenerate with a template, or delete the summary.
  • Switching between Summary and Action Items no longer flashes the Enhanced page.

ThisWeek Desktop 0.1.21

Live transcript no longer goes blank when Local Whisper has no model installed.

  • If Whisper is selected but no model is downloaded, live transcription falls back to ThisWeek automatically.
  • Clearer transcript pane status while recording, plus an error when live STT cannot start.
  • Settings → Transcription warns when Whisper needs a model download.

ThisWeek Desktop 0.1.20

Calendar settings and clearer menu-bar countdowns.

  • Menu bar countdown uses hours and minutes (for example “in 4h 8m”).
  • New Settings → Calendar tab to control menu-bar meetings and visible calendars.
  • Option to hide events with no participants or video link from the menu bar.
